subject: psychiatry
title: Suicide Risk Evaluation and Deliberate Self-Harm

steps.tx: **Suicide risk factors** encompass sociodemographic, clinical, and psychological variables, among which a prior suicide attempt stands as the single strongest predictor of future completed suicide. Additional clinical risk multipliers include comorbid severe depression, bipolar disorder, schizophrenia, alcohol misuse, and borderline personality disorder.
steps.say: A previous suicide attempt is the single most powerful predictor of completed suicide. Major depression, bipolar illness, and substance use multiply risk.

left.title: Demographic & Social Factors
points: Male sex completes suicide four times more often
Elderly age groups and young adults

right.title: Clinical & Historical Factors
points: Prior suicide attempt is the strongest predictor
Severe major depressive or mixed affective episode

steps.tx: **Completed suicide versus attempted suicide** reveals a well-documented epidemiological paradox where women attempt suicide three times more frequently than men, but men complete suicide at three to four times higher rates. This disparity stems primarily from men selecting highly lethal and irreversible methods such as hanging, firearms, and jumping.
steps.say: Women attempt suicide more often, but men complete suicide three to four times more frequently because they use more lethal methods like hanging.

vis.title: Epidemiological Gender Disparity
rows: Three to four times higher completion rate

steps.tx: **Deliberate self-harm**, or non-suicidal self-injury, involves intentional direct destruction of body tissue, such as superficial skin cutting, burning, or scratching, in the absence of lethal intent. Frequently encountered in borderline personality disorder, it functions primarily as a maladaptive mechanism to regulate overwhelming emotional distress.
steps.say: Non-suicidal self-injury involves tissue damage like superficial cutting without intent to die. It is often used to relieve overwhelming emotional distress.

left.title: Non-Suicidal Self-Injury
points: Absence of conscious intent to end life
Primary goal is emotional tension relief

right.title: Suicide Attempt
points: Explicit or implicit intent to die
Primary goal is permanent cessation of consciousness
Carries high medical urgency and mortality

steps.tx: **SAD PERSONS scale** is an established bedside clinical mnemonic used to quantify suicide risk across ten weighted factors: Sex male, Age under 19 or over 45, Depression, Previous attempt, Ethanol abuse, Rational thinking loss, Social support lacking, Organised plan, No spouse, and Sickness.
steps.say: The SAD PERSONS scale evaluates suicide risk through ten factors including male sex, extreme age, depression, previous attempts, and absence of social support.

vis.title: SAD PERSONS Mnemonic & Triage
rows: Score 0 to 4: Low risk; outpatient psychiatric follow-up
Score 5 to 6: Moderate risk; consider psychiatric admission
Score 7 to 8: High risk; involuntary or voluntary hospitalization
Score 9 to 10: Extreme risk; immediate secure ward admission
Detailed lethal plan, available means, isolation
Divorced, widowed, or chronic debilitating disease

steps.tx: **Durkheim sociological types of suicide** classify self-harm based on an individual's integration into society and societal regulation. Altruistic suicide arises from excessive integration where the individual sacrifices their life for the group, while egoistic suicide results from profound social detachment and isolation.
steps.say: Durkheim identified four types of suicide: altruistic from excessive social integration, egoistic from extreme isolation, anomic from societal collapse, and fatalistic from oppression.

vis.title: Durkheimian Typology of Suicide
rows: Kamikaze pilots, military self-sacrifice for collective good
Socially isolated, unmarried individuals lacking community bonds
Sudden economic collapse, market crashes, catastrophic societal shifts
Severe slavery, prison oppression, totalitarian regimes

steps.tx: **Mental Healthcare Act 2017 decriminalisation** under Section 115 provides that any person attempting suicide is presumed to be under severe stress, thereby decriminalizing suicide attempts under Section 309 of the Indian Penal Code. The government is legally mandated to provide emergency medical and psychiatric treatment, care, and rehabilitation.
steps.say: Section 115 of the Mental Healthcare Act 2017 presumes severe stress during a suicide attempt, decriminalizing the act and guaranteeing medical rehabilitation.

right.title: Clinical Mandates
points: No police clearance required for treatment

steps.tx: **Lethality and intent assessment** evaluates both the objective physical danger of the method used and the patient's subjective belief regarding its lethality. Premeditation, taking steps to prevent discovery, leaving suicide notes, making testamentary wills, and profound regret at surviving signify exceptionally high ongoing suicide lethality.
steps.say: Evaluating lethality weighs the objective danger of the method against the patient's intent. Writing suicide notes and taking precautions against discovery signal high risk.

left.title: High Intent Indicators
points: Locking doors and hiding from rescue
Leaving written suicide notes or wills
Careful timing when relatives are away

right.title: Low Intent Indicators
points: Attempt performed in front of family
Immediate call for medical help after act

steps.tx: **Lithium and clozapine protective effects** represent a unique clinical finding in psychiatric pharmacotherapy, as they are the only medications proven in randomized clinical trials to reduce completed suicide rates. Lithium reduces completed suicide in bipolar and major depressive disorders, while clozapine demonstrates specific anti-suicidal efficacy in schizophrenia.
steps.say: Lithium and clozapine are the only psychiatric medications clinically proven to reduce completed suicide rates in bipolar illness and schizophrenia.

left.title: Lithium Anti-Suicidal Action
points: Reduces completed suicide five-fold in bipolar disorder

right.title: Clozapine Anti-Suicidal Action
points: Proven reduction in suicide attempts in schizophrenia
FDA-approved indication for suicidal behavior in psychosis
Reduces persistent despair and auditory hallucinations
